question: Does the frozen self-adaptive deployment form, re-selected under the leak-free replay, pass robustly at untouched ICU sites without any local calibration study?

databases.SICdb: Salzburg Intensive Care database 1.0.8 (PhysioNet), single site
databases.HiRID: HiRID (PhysioNet, Bern University Hospital), single site

prior_project_use: SICdb: archive re-downloaded 2026-10-27 and extracted (cases, laboratory, data_float_h, unitlog, d_references); only support counts, timestamps, unit codes and LogState codes were inspected, never a target value; the extractor had two data-free Codex reviews. HiRID: stored in the researcher's cloud, not on this machine, never read. Neither database was used by any model line of this project.
development_data_used_for_this_system: MIMIC-IV v5 transitions (training); eICU harmonized_20261022, NWICU v5, Zigong v2, Emory v2 (selection and re-evaluation after the 2026-10-22 leak fix). Emory and Zigong were lockboxes once and are development data since.
supersedes: adaptive_model_lockbox_protocol_v9_20261027.json (no step was ever claimed under it; nothing was scored). v10 changes only the lockbox enforcement in site_adaptive_external_audit.py: scoring requires every one of the six horizon files of --external-template to be recorded (and unchanged) in the addendum, before the one-shot step is claimed; v9 required only one. The deployment form, cohorts and scores are unchanged, so the development reference stays valid.

deployment_form.training: MIMIC-IV v5 transitions only (all anchors kept, label offsets recorded)
deployment_form.point_model: per-cell recipe from deployment_recipes_20261024.json (47 catalog continuous cells + 6 glucose_poc cells), re-selected under the leak-free replay
deployment_form.persistence_fallback: cells with recipe 'persistence' output the current value without point correction, make no point claim, and are gated on the interval only
deployment_form.point_recalibration: affine_0.005 (site_adaptive_point_amendment_20261024.json; a post-hoc amendment approved 2026-10-24 and disclosed in online_config_reselection_protocol_20261023.json)
deployment_form.interval: quintile value-bin normalization + DtACI meta rate 5, site and care-unit levels, new-site starting log multiplier theta0 = 0 (site_adaptive_dtaci_dev_20261024.json, site_adaptive_dtaci_prior_dev_20261024.json)
deployment_form.network_sharing: multi-hospital deployments only (site_adaptive_network_dev_20261024.json); SICdb and HiRID are single sites, so it is inactive
deployment_form.replay: deployment clock (osler_jepa.deployment_clock): stays arrive in a random (seeded) Poisson order; an outcome may update adaptive state only once the clock passes anchor + h + |label offset| (a conservative deadline, not the measurement time); a stay change never resolves pending outcomes

out_of_scope.binary_event_cells: not re-evaluated on the development databases after the 2026-10-22 leak fix; multi_sample_external_audit.py refuses lockbox scoring under this protocol
out_of_scope.jepa_cells: the 4 robust JEPA cells (jepa_gate_samples0to4_20261025.json) remain development candidates; a lockbox would need SICdb/HiRID canonical event examples and 5 samples x 7 seeds of training (about 45 h)

preconditions_before_any_label_is_read: data access under PhysioNet credentialing and each database's terms

an extractor per database producing transitions in the MIMIC-IV v5 contract: 6 h anchor step, 6 h look-back, every anchor kept, label = nearest measurement within min(2, h/2) h of anchor + h with its offset recorded, 72 h episode cap, plausibility cleaning as in mimiciv_observation_transition_extract.py, derived measurements as in osler_jepa/derived_measurements.py

variable mapping declared from the data dictionary only: glucose = chemistry laboratory glucose; point-of-care -> glucose_poc; blood-gas glucose -> glucose_bg (if a database does not distinguish them, glucose and glucose_poc cells are not evaluable); urine output in mL/h; MAP = measured mean pressure

lockbox_addendum.py --protocol <this file> --database <db> --files <extractor, mapping, every extraction output>: a one-shot receipt in causal_executions/<protocol sha256>/ written before extracted labels are opened; before it only support counts and timestamps may be inspected, never target values

evaluation.command: python site_adaptive_external_audit.py --database <SICdb|HiRID> --external-template <the addendum's {horizon} template> --protocol <this file> --output site_adaptive_lockbox_<db>_v10.json (every other option at its default; the script checks the invocation against deployment_form_arguments, the addendum receipt (all six horizon files recorded and unchanged) and the hashes, and claims the one-shot step continuous_<db>)
evaluation.cells: all 49 catalog cells' continuous members plus the 6 glucose_poc cells; cells a site does not record are not evaluable
evaluation.samples: 5 MIMIC training samples; robust = full gate passes in >= 80% of samples
evaluation.gate: unchanged: point = patient-level paired bootstrap upper bound < 0 against persistence and the recipe's comparator; interval = patient- and care-unit-equal coverage in [0.87, 0.93]

primary_endpoint: per database: number of evaluable continuous cells robust under point_and_dtaci_adaptive
decision_rule: cells robust on both SICdb and HiRID are independently replicated adaptive cells; robust on one = candidate. Any registry change requires the user's approval.

development_reference_not_a_prediction.source: site_adaptive_amended_*_20261024.json (in-sample: recipes, theta0 and the point amendment were selected on these databases)

one_shot_rule: each database is scored once (ledger step continuous_<db>); only crashes may be fixed, without changing methods, gates or cohorts, and every fix is reported
refreeze_rule: if any hashed file changes before scoring, a new protocol version must be frozen before any label is read

replay_properties_disclosed.source: CODEX_REVIEW_SICDB_EXTRACTOR_ROUND2_20261027.md findings 3-5; frozen as designed because the development reference was produced by the same replay
replay_properties_disclosed.arrival_order: random stay arrivals: no calendar chronology across patients, and a patient's later admission may arrive before an earlier one (no patient-level adaptation in this form; histories are within a stay)
replay_properties_disclosed.label_selected_stream: the replayed stream holds only anchors with a finite plausible label (normalize_cohort), so the simulated arrival rate and the warm-up cohort depend on whether a future measurement exists (never on its value); unlabelled anchors could not update state anyway
replay_properties_disclosed.feedback_order: outcomes due between two forecasts are applied in forecast order, not in resolution-time order (Codex example: third-width difference 0.0002)
